[[Gift of Craftsmanship]] is a [[gift]] used in crafting of [[Legendary armor|legendary armor]].

== Acquisition ==
{{Sold by}}

== Used in ==
{{Recipe list}}

== Notes ==
* One Gift of Craftsmanship is required to craft each piece of PvE legendary armor. It is not used to craft WvW and PvP legendary armors.
* Although the in-game description only says "A gift used to create legendary armor", it's also used to create legendary runes, sigils, and relics.
* One equipped legendary set requires up to 22 gifts: 6 armor pieces, 7 runes (for armor and the breathing apparatus), 8 sigils (for all land and aquatic weapon sets), and 1 relic. This totals 1100 [[Provisioner Token]]s.
* For a complete [[Legendary Armory]] it would take 54 gifts: 8 sigils, 7 runes, 1 relic, and 38 armor pieces (2 weights of Eikasia gloves, 18 Envoy armor pieces & 18 Obsidian armor pieces). This is equivalent to 2700 Provisioner Tokens.

== Trivia ==
* The Gift of Craftsmanship used to use the same icon as the [[Gift of Battle]] but was given a unique icon with the [[Game updates/2024-03-19|March 19, 2024]] game update.
